summary: Complete factor research pipeline: project setup → data loading → factor definition/audit → experiment tracking → backtest → report → AI templates. 8 tasks in 4 waves, linear pipeline with governance-first design.
approach: Incremental build following research lifecycle order. Each wave produces testable artifacts. Governance constraints (time-aware metadata, experiment preservation, explicit assumptions) embedded from Wave 1.

waves.goal: Data loading with time-aware metadata validation

waves.label: Factor + Experiment

waves.label: Backtest + Report + AI
